newsitem.title: USA: World Airways Sept block hours 2,970.
newsitem.headline: World Airways Sept block hours 2,970.

text.p: World Airways Inc said Monday block hours flown for continuing operations, consisting of contracts with international air carriers, the U.S. government and international tour operators, rose 8 percent to 2,970 for September, compared to 2,747 for September 1995.
For the year-to-date ended September 30, block hours totaled 31,344, about a 25 percent increase from 27,148 for the same period last year, the company said.
World Airways handles worldwide passenger and cargo air transportation under contracts with international airlines, the U.S. Air Force and international tour operators.
